proposed_comments.title: Treat Windows absolute paths as file URLs

confidence.rationale: The condition directly matches the current line and the failure follows from Node ESM treating drive-letter strings as unsupported URL schemes.

proposed_comments.body:
### Treat Windows absolute paths as file URLs

**Severity:** `high`

On Windows, an entry like `C:\extensions\main.js` matches the generic URI-scheme regex because of the drive-letter colon, so the bootstrapper returns it unchanged. Dynamic `import()` then treats that string as an unsupported URL scheme instead of a filesystem path, which prevents normal Windows extension entries from starting.

```suggestion
  if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z\d+.-]*:/.test(raw) && !/^[a-zA-Z]:[\\/]/.test(raw)) {
```

proposed_comments.title: Reject malformed Content-Length headers

confidence.rationale: The current parser uses parseInt on the wire framing length, and the replacement preserves valid lengths while rejecting malformed or unsafe values.

proposed_comments.title: Validate JSON-RPC 2.0 messages and allow error responses with null ids

confidence.rationale: The existing guards omit the JSON-RPC version check, and JSON-RPC requires null ids for parse/invalid-request responses when no request id is available.

proposed_comments.title: Return protocol errors for malformed or unsupported input

confidence.rationale: The current code has explicit continue/drop paths for parse failures and unsupported messages, and dispose finalization is currently invoked without chaining behind queued work.

proposed_comments.title: Retire stale fallback commands when no fallbacks are returned

confidence.rationale: The stale registry is observable in the current control flow: the early return skips the same retireMissing path used when a replacement fallback list exists.

proposed_comments.title: Prevent generated form ids from colliding with explicit ids

confidence.rationale: The current map assignment overwrites duplicate form ids, and generated ids are predictable strings that can collide with explicit content ids.

proposed_comments.title: Expose list filter changes to extension pages

confidence.rationale: The runtime already calls setFilter by method name, but the public TypeScript interface omits it from implementable list pages.

proposed_comments.title: Put setting labels on the Adaptive Card inputs

confidence.rationale: Adaptive Cards support input labels, and the current generated JSON leaves the label outside the associated input control.

proposed_comments.title: Handle asynchronous launcher failures

confidence.rationale: The Node child_process API emits spawn failures asynchronously, and the current code detaches without registering an error listener.

proposed_comments.title: Dispose providers that resolve after shutdown

confidence.rationale: The asynchronous init continuation currently writes provider state unconditionally, even after the disposed flag has been set.

proposed_comments.title: Do not send command-bearing objects through propChanged

confidence.rationale: The listed complex properties can contain commands or page objects, while this helper bypasses the WireSerializer registry.

proposed_comments.title: Serialize tree children in deterministic form-id order

confidence.rationale: The shared FormCollector is mutable, and Promise.all allows generated IDs to depend on asynchronous completion order instead of content traversal order.

proposed_comments.title: Serialize content blocks in deterministic form-id order

confidence.rationale: The current top-level Promise.all shares one mutable FormCollector across async content blocks, creating the same ordering hazard as nested tree serialization.

proposed_comments.title: Let all list pages notify item refreshes

confidence.rationale: The current helper is implemented only on DynamicListPageBase even though the host refresh method applies to list pages generally.

proposed_comments.title: Avoid duplicating the inherited list refresh helper

confidence.rationale: This is the companion cleanup required after adding notifyItemsChanged to ListPageBase; otherwise the dynamic page class retains redundant implementation.

proposed_comments.title: Add SDK CI and regression coverage

confidence.rationale: The current PR introduces a standalone SDK with many runtime protocol edge cases, and the fixes above are regression-prone without automated coverage and CI.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add SDK CI and regression coverage

**Severity:** `medium`

Please add coverage for the protocol and lifecycle fixes above, including Windows path bootstrap resolution, malformed frame resynchronization, JSON-RPC parse/invalid-request responses, fallback retirement, form id collision handling, deterministic form ids across async content, list-page refresh notifications, and asynchronous URL launcher failures. It would also help to add a dedicated SDK workflow that runs install, typecheck, lint, tests, build, and package verification whenever the TypeScript SDK changes.
